scope: Reclassify prior source/capture stops as science-evaluated failures, transport/access false negatives, or still-untested candidates. This audit does not change the algorithm, frozen geometry formula, thresholds, RGB boundary, or Android authority.

findings.historical_issue: R1 rejected solid archives because reaching aligned depth required transient traversal of interleaved color members.
findings.correction: Evidence Access and Transport Standard R1 allowed compressed transport and transient discard without RGB output, inspection, decoding, selection influence, or algorithm use.
findings.interpretation: The early transport stop wasted time but did not hide a passing source under the unchanged scientific gate.
The accepted-license and source-authority work was necessary; the later geometry result, not the access gate, is the current reason for exclusion.

findings.false_negative_risk: The old fixed-small-capture policy did not establish a family-wide scientific failure. Other source-native captures remain eligible only through a separately reviewed future lock.

findings.near_gate_note: One indoor_flying1 window reached positive fraction 0.8434343434 but only 4.602005004 s continuous positive duration, below the unchanged 5.0 s requirement.
findings.false_negative_risk: The tested captures genuinely fail the tuple, but the result is not family-wide authority against every MVSEC capture.
Unconsumed registered captures were not scientifically evaluated and must not be described as geometry failures.

findings.interpretation: After correcting the timestamp-unit bug and independently reviewing all eligible non-test captures, this is a family-wide timegrid failure under the unchanged dt <= 0.1 s gate.

findings.false_negative_risk: This capture cannot pass the unchanged cadence gate, but no family-wide KITTI Raw exclusion is authorized.

retired_rules: Treating any RGB member byte traversal as RGB scientific access
Promoting a capture-local failure to a source-family failure without official family-wide evidence
retained_scientific_rules: Earliest synchronized non-overlapping 10 s half-open windows with no sliding
At least 90 source-consecutive pairs and every pair dt <= 0.1 s
Coverage >= 0.8 with fixed denominator and no imputation
Each independent source must supply one positive and one below-reference window
No RGB algorithm execution and no Android

next_action: Continue only with separately locked exact captures; do not rewrite geometry-tested failures as access failures, and do not rewrite untested captures as geometry failures.
